name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 20 - Am 70
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 20a. Calls for energy democracy to be fully embedded in housing policy; believes that the Commission must ensure citizens’ and communities’ ownership of the energy transition and participation in it, ensuring access to renewable, affordable, energy-efficient homes as a housing right;
